source_caption:
🎥🎬: She’s the Man (2006)

When Viola’s girls’ soccer team is cut from her school, she decides to prove that she can compete just as well as the boys. After her twin brother Sebastian secretly leaves town, Viola disguises herself as him and enrolls at his boarding school to join the boys’ soccer team.

Keeping her identity hidden becomes increasingly difficult as Viola develops feelings for her roommate, Duke, while Duke is interested in another girl. Between soccer matches, romantic confusion, and trying not to get caught, Viola finds herself trapped in a hilarious web of secrets.

As the truth finally comes out, Viola gets the chance to prove herself on the field and show everyone that talent has nothing to do with gender.

source_details.title: She's the Man
source_details.synopsis: She's the Man is a 2006 American romantic comedy teen sports film directed by Andy Fickman and starring Amanda Bynes, Channing Tatum, Laura Ramsey, Vinnie Jones, and David Cross. Inspired by William Shakespeare's play Twelfth Night, the film centers on teenager Viola Hastings, who enrolls at her brother's new boarding school, Illyria Prep, in his place and pretends to be a boy in order to play on the boys' soccer team. She's the Man emerged as a moderate commercial success, grossing $57.2 million against a budget of $20–25 million. The film received mixed reviews from critics, but Bynes's performance was universally praised and developed a cult following.
